buyer: open-model release maintainer or release engineer
input: one real release manifest declaring exactly eight artifacts, local or HTTP, at most 10 MiB
workflow: emit a JSON receipt and a static HTML receipt
acceptance: PASS only at 8/8 matching artifacts and loader exit 0
any missing path, changed byte, timeout, or loader error is FAIL with the exact stage
inputs are capped at 10 MiB and 60 seconds
deliverables: independent completeness verdict for one release manifest

commercial.refund: If the accepted diagnostic is not delivered inside the one-business-day window, the paid diagnostic amount is refunded unless the buyer elects in writing to receive one free next-business-day repair instead.

data_boundary: local or HTTP artifacts only; no database; no model training
decision_boundary: completeness receipt only; no training-quality claim and no production deployment
